options.name: dest
options.description: The destination file path. For downloads, this is the local file path. For uploads, this is the remote file path on the SFTP server.

options.name: host
options.description: The IP address or the FQDN of the remote SFTP host.

options.name: password
options.description: Password for the SFTP connection. Required if 'private_key' is not provided.

options.name: port
options.description: The TCP port of the remote SFTP host. The default port is 22.

options.name: private_key
options.description: Path to the private key file for key-based authentication. Required if 'password' is not provided.

options.name: state
options.description: Specifies the action to perform. It can be either 'download' or 'upload'.
